# paste-images

Pasting or dropping an image into a text editor uploads it as an attachment and
inserts an inline image node. The node renders as `AttachmentThumbnail`: a
64px `ViewerThumbnail size="chip"` (`primitives/overlay/image-viewer`) that opens
the full-window viewer, with a hover-revealed Remove button while the editor is
editable. The task description's read-only display reuses the same chip.
